title: The Four Freedoms: evidence and medium
prompt: Answer each question in two or three complete sentences. Quote the text to support your answers.

items.prompt: Roosevelt lists "the basic things expected by our people." Choose two and explain what they suggest about his priorities for the country.
Roosevelt says the four freedoms are "no vision of a distant millennium." What does he mean, and what in the speech supports this claim?

Roosevelt delivered this speech aloud to Congress, and it was broadcast on the radio. How might hearing the repeated phrase "everywhere in the world" affect a listener differently than reading it on the page?
